_comment: Hand-maintained overlay on reference/country_mapping.json (which py/get_iso_codes.py regenerates and would wipe added fields).
defaults apply to every country; countries.{ISO} overrides them. A country listed here with pilot=true is in pipeline scope
ONLY when named explicitly (e.g. run_all_countries.sh --only NPL, validate_quality.py NPL). No default loop - run queue,
preflight, dashboard, supervisor, status page - includes pilot countries. See docs/technical/nepal-integration-plan.md.
